}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== This is a [[Broadcom]]-based router built to be managed using [[Cisco]]/[[Meraki]] cloud control panel. :Limited information is available. The default lan IP address is 192.168.1.1 Telnet is available at least until the meraki cloud takes over. :The default nvram variables give a clue to basic setup. Variables exist for radios, which are not present on the board. :A minimal gui-based configuation as also avalable.
